name: Subsea boosting and multiphase pumps
principle: Pumps on the seabed add pressure to the multiphase stream to raise flow and recovery. Pazflor (800 m, 2011) uses six pumps plus two spares at 13.8 MW with up to 105 bar differential; Draugen (1994) was the first, at 1 MW and 53 bar.

process_steps.name: Helico-axial or twin-screw pump adds pressure
